title.en: Unit Digit & Number of Trailing Zeros
title.hi: इकाई अंक एवं अनुगामी शून्यों (Trailing Zeros) की संख्या

definition.en: Compute unit digits of large exponents using 4-cyclicity and trailing zeros in factorial expansions via Legendre formula.

learningOutcomes.en: Master problem-solving for Unit Digit & Number of Trailing Zeros
learningOutcomes.hi: समस्या समाधान में दक्षता प्राप्त करें

content.en:
1. Unit Digit Cyclicity:
• Cyclicity 1: {0, 1, 5, 6} → Always end in 0, 1, 5, 6 respectively for any positive power.
• Cyclicity 2: {4, 9} → 4odd=4, 4even=6; 9odd=9, 9even=1.
• Cyclicity 4: {2, 3, 7, 8} → Divide power by 4; if remainder is r, evaluate digitr (if remainder is 0, evaluate digit4).

2. Trailing Zeros in N! (Legendre's Formula):
A trailing zero is created by every 2 × 5 pair. In any factorial, 2s are abundant, so the number of zeros is governed by the power of 5:
Number of Trailing Zeros = ⌊N/5⌋ + ⌊N/25⌋ + ⌊N/125⌋ + ⌊N/625⌋ + ...

content.en: Cyclicity of Unit Digits (Pattern 4) | Number of Zeros in N! = [N/5] + [N/25] + [N/125] + ...

content.en:
Illustrative Problem: Find the number of trailing zeros in 100!
Solution: ⌊100/5⌋ + ⌊100/25⌋ = 20 + 4 = 24 zeros.

question.en: What is the unit digit in the expansion of (7^95 - 3^58)?
question.hi: What is the unit digit in the expansion of (7^95 - 3^58)?

explanation.en: For 7^95: Divide 95 by 4 => 95 = 4*23 + 3 (remainder 3). Unit digit = 7³ = 343 => 3. For 3^58: Divide 58 by 4 => 58 = 4*14 + 2 (remainder 2). Unit digit = 3² = 9. Unit digit of (7^95 - 3^58) = (3 - 9) + 10 (borrowing 1 from tens place) = 4.
